verdict.rationale: Serving embedding models is a fair question for a local LLM runtime and server, so the axis applies. The evidence documents an HTTP server and API, chat, CLI, multimodal and speech-to-text modes, but nothing about embedding models or an embeddings endpoint for retrieval or search. A generic server with an API does not count as embedding serving.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve embedding models for retrieval and search applications
